cases._comment: READ THIS ONE — no string match detects the failure that matters, which is an invented count presented as observed. maxChars guards against a wall of text, not a target: it first fired at 1210 on a reply that correctly summarised every other case, reported a real score change with its reason, and explicitly refused to invent churn risks. containsAny is a floor for the no-data case; an earlier version used ["no","not"], which match as substrings inside "know" and "nothing" and would have passed anything.
